title: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Personalized Health Checkup Interpretation and Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2610.01451v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized interpretation of health checkup results requires reasoning across longitudinal records, medical knowledge, lifestyle guidance, and healthcare navigation. We present a multi-agent large language model (LLM) system that identifies multiple intents, maps each to a task-specific agent, executes them in parallel, and synthesizes their outputs. We compared answers generated in Single Agent and Multi Agent settings on 120 Korean compound queries combining two to four requirements, using synthetic health checkup records. The Multi Agent improved the weighted LLM-judge score from 1.695 to 1.797 (p = 0.027), and three additional LLM judges showed consistent improvements ($\Delta$ = +0.111 to +0.186, all p < 0.05). translated_title: 一种用于个性化健康体检解读与指导的多智能体大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: 个性化解读健康体检结果需要跨纵向记录、医学知识、生活方式指导和就医导航进行综合推理。我们提出了一个多智能体大语言模型系统，该系统能够识别多个意图，将每个意图映射到特定任务的智能体，并行执行这些任务，并综合各智能体的输出结果。我们使用合成的健康体检记录，在120个结合两到四项需求的韩语复合查询上，对单智能体与多智能体设置下生成的答案进行了比较。多智能体系统将加权LLM评判得分从1.695提升至1.797（p = 0.027），另外三个LLM评判者也显示出一致的改进（Δ = +0.111至+0.186，均p < 0.05）。性能提升主要来源于有用性、一致性以及对复合查询中各项需求的完整处理，而数值准确性和事实依据性仅在四个评判者之一的情况下显著改善，医疗安全性……
tldr: 该论文提出一个多智能体大语言模型框架，通过识别用户的多重意图、将其分配给专门的智能体并行执行并综合输出，显著提升了个性化健康体检解读与指导的质量，尤其在处理复合查询方面优于单智能体方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-agent LLM framework that identifies multiple user intents, dispatches them to task-specific agents running in parallel, and synthesizes their outputs, significantly improving personalized health checkup interpretation and guidance, especially for compound queries compared to a single-agent approach.
